Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a program to certify and market certain cattle from Washington as either "natural beef cattle" or "natural grass-fed beef cattle."

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to naturally raised beef cattle; and adding a newsection to chapter 15.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 15.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall administer a program to certify and marketbeef cattle from Washington as either: (a) Washingtoncertified natural beef cattle; or (b) Washingtoncertified natural grassfed beef cattle. (2) To qualify as Washingtoncertified natural beef cattle, cattlemust be: (a) Born and raised in Washington; and (b) Raised and finished: (i) In an environmentally prudent manner; (ii) Pursuant to beef quality assurance standards; (iii) Without subtherapeutic antibiotics, hormones, growthpromotants, or ionophores; and (iv) Only on natural feed not containing drugs, chemicals, oranimal byproducts. p. 1 SB 5005 (3) To qualify as Washingtoncertified natural grassfed beefcattle, cattle must meet the requirements of subsection (2) of thissection and must also be raised and finished on grass. (4) The department shall adopt rules specifying certificationstandards, including recordkeeping and verification protocols thatrequire: (a) Maintaining cattle birth and health records, including vaccinelot numbers, vaccine manufacturers, and vaccination dates; and (b) At least one inspection of the farm or ranch of origin. (5) The department shall include promotion of beef from Washingtoncertified natural beef cattle and Washingtoncertified natural grassfed beef cattle in its agricultural product marketing programs.
